description:
Enter and abandon all hope in the most terrifying Realm in the world. This is a tale no mortal can witness without gibbering into madness!

Each year, on October 31st, the nefarious spirits of Pirates and Ninjas rise from their graves to wage their eternal war. Each side seeks to woo a living maiden and take her back to Hell to rule as Queen of the Undead. Dead Pirate Captain Mad "Jolly" McMadman and his crew clash with the dreaded Ninja Clan of the Thousand Cuts, led by Naga the Snake, the deadliest Dead Ninja alive! Witness as they vie (and murder) for the attentions of the fair Druscilla, the Waif Princess da Vinci. From midnight to midnight on the Day of Blood, no other mortal they encounter can be allowed to live! When Ghost Pirates and Ninjas come a-callin', lock up your daughters and throw away the keys!

issue_title: Sherlock Holmes : Adventure of the Musgrave Ritual

description: A one-shot set in an alternate-history 1939 Germany, in which aliens have invaded the Earth. At a super-science center known as Valhalla, soldiers and scientists of various nationalities gather to find ways to combat the alien weapons technology. A young girl is caught in the middle of the conflict when she stumbles upon the greatest power the world has ever seen.

At last, in his own series, the man with vision so good, he can see into tomorrow! Thrill to the adventures of Tomorrow Man as he enters the "toughest contest in the world" to determine the fate of history. Witness the revelation of his origin! All this plus all new story and art!

A manga-style spoof of alternate-history stories, including Nomuras own Families of Altered Wars. After aliens crash-land on Earth during World War II, they decide to give the leaders of the Axis and Allied powers mecha suits, and let them duke it out in person. An outrageous concept enlivened by pop-culture jokes and a backup story exploring the history of flying saucers.

Hold onto your "slay" bells! The mental mire that is David Hutchison's brain has disgorged yet another engagingly disturbing adventure of everyone's favorite maniacal moppets, Mischief and Mayhem! The girls' dreams come true when they learn the secret location of Santa's workshop! The fun then begins as the girls trek to bring their dear Santa a gift -- no matter what! Together we learn a jolly ol' secret about Saint Nick and get to see special guest appearances by a host of other holiday icons! Fun for the whole family! (We won't say which family.)

series_title: Gold Digger Adventures Stand Alone Special
description: The origin of the Pink Avenger revealed! It's GD minus 12 as the fertile imagination and flashing pen of Fred Perry take you back to a turning point in the childhood of your favorite GD characters! Vice-Principal Venomiss is sick of schoolkids having fun on her time, and she and Dorris the cafeteria worker are going to do something about it! It's up to comic-book fan and would-be superhero Danielle Carter to stop them—if she can convince her new friend Britanny Diggers to help!
